title: Forbidden Arts Beneath the Lake - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Forbidden Arts Beneath the Lake trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Forbidden Arts Beneath the Lake phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. One of the nine purple side quests, and one of the two that also carries a silver rather than a bronze.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete the side quest Secrets at the Heart of the Lake.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: This entry is filled from the shipped game on either platform; PS5 trophy and PC achievement lists are recorded separately where they differ. See the trophy guide for the full list and how long to beat for run-length context.
